option.value:
name: Monitor solid_queue Upstream
on: schedule: # Run daily at 06:00 UTC - cron: "0 6 * * *" workflow_dispatch: inputs: force_tag: description: "Override solid_queue tag to compare against (e.g. v1.5.0). Leave blank to use latest." required: false default: ""
permissions: contents: write issues: write
jobs: check-upstream: name: Check for new solid_queue release runs-on: ubuntu-latest
steps: - name: Checkout repository uses: actions/checkout@v4
# ── Determine latest solid_queue release ────────────────────────────── - name: Get latest solid_queue release id: upstream env: GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} run: | if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.force_tag }}" ]; then LATEST_TAG="${{ github.event.inputs.force_tag }}" else LATEST_TAG=$(gh release view --repo rails/solid_queue --json tagName -q '.tagName') fi echo "latest_tag=${LATEST_TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" echo "Upstream latest tag: ${LATEST_TAG}"
# ── Compare with last processed version ─────────────────────────────── - name: Read last checked version id: last_version run: | LAST=$(cat .github/last_checked_solid_queue_version | tr -d '[:space:]') echo "last_tag=${LAST}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" echo "Last checked tag: ${LAST}"
- name: Check if update is needed id: needs_update run: | LATEST="${{ steps.upstream.outputs.latest_tag }}" LAST="${{ steps.last_version.outputs.last_tag }}" if [ "$LATEST" = "$LAST" ] && [ "${{ github.event_name }}" != "workflow_dispatch" ]; then echo "No new release. Skipping." echo "proceed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" else echo "New release detected: ${LATEST} (last checked: ${LAST})" echo "proceed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" fi
# ── Check if an issue for this version already exists ───────────────── - name: Check for existing sync issue id: issue_check if: steps.needs_update.outputs.proceed == 'true' env: GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} run: | TAG="${{ steps.upstream.outputs.latest_tag }}" EXISTING=$(gh issue list --label "upstream-sync" --state open --search "$TAG" --json number -q '.[0].number') if [ -n "$EXISTING" ]; then echo "Open issue #${EXISTING} already exists for ${TAG}. Skipping." echo "issue_exists=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" else echo "issue_exists=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" fi
# ── Set up Ruby for the comparison script ───────────────────────────── - name: Set up Ruby if: | steps.needs_update.outputs.proceed == 'true' && steps.issue_check.outputs.issue_exists == 'false' uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1 with: ruby-version: "3.3"
# ── Run comparison script ───────────────────────────────────────────── - name: Compare models if: | steps.needs_update.outputs.proceed == 'true' && steps.issue_check.outputs.issue_exists == 'false' id: compare env: GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} run: | OLD_TAG="${{ steps.last_version.outputs.last_tag }}" NEW_TAG="${{ steps.upstream.outputs.latest_tag }}" # Compare upstream old tag vs new tag — NOT vs our local models ruby .github/scripts/compare_models.rb "$OLD_TAG" "$NEW_TAG" > /tmp/issue_body.md echo "--- Issue Body Preview ---" cat /tmp/issue_body.md
# ── Always bump version tracking on default branch ─────────────────── - name: Update version tracking file if: | steps.needs_update.outputs.proceed == 'true' && steps.issue_check.outputs.issue_exists == 'false' && steps.compare.conclusion == 'success' run: | TAG="${{ steps.upstream.outputs.latest_tag }}" git config user.name "github-actions[bot]" git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com" echo "$TAG" > .github/last_checked_solid_queue_version git add .github/last_checked_solid_queue_version git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "chore: track solid_queue upstream version ${TAG}" git push origin HEAD
# ── Create issue and assign to Copilot if there are model changes ───── - name: Create Copilot issue for model changes if: | steps.needs_update.outputs.proceed == 'true' && steps.issue_check.outputs.issue_exists == 'false' && steps.compare.conclusion == 'success' env: GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} run: | # Only open an issue if there are actual upstream model changes if grep -q "No model changes detected" /tmp/issue_body.md; then echo "No model changes — skipping issue creation." exit 0 fi
OLD_TAG="${{ steps.last_version.outputs.last_tag }}" NEW_TAG="${{ steps.upstream.outputs.latest_tag }}" TITLE="chore: solid_queue ${OLD_TAG} → ${NEW_TAG} — update Mongoid models for upstream changes"
gh issue create \ --title "$TITLE" \ --body-file /tmp/issue_body.md \ --label "upstream-sync" \ --assignee "Copilot"
